description: A request body over maxRequestBodyBytes is answered 413 with reason phrase "Content Too Large" (RFC 9110) without calling the handler. The edge forwards Expect: 100-continue; the SDK never sends a 1xx, so the 413 is the first thing it writes (expect_continue_200 shows the request the app receives when Expect is present). MCPWARP.md §4
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: notes-tester.mcpwarp.test
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
expect: 100-continue
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 95

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"search","arguments":{"q":"x"}}}
out:
HTTP/1.1 413 Content Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 34

{"error":"request body too large"}
notes: With Content-Length the cap is checked before any body byte is read; with chunked framing it is checked cumulatively and the SDK MAY have consumed up to one transport chunk past the cap before answering.
